confirmed: XRP is about $1.05 early Thursday, down about 0.7% over 24 hours, about 20% lower than 7 days ago and about 23% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:24 AM MST; $1.0538 last trade on Kraken (Kraken 24h range $1.0361 to $1.0795)). Wednesday's daily close was about $1.05, near the 60-session low of about $1.03 set Tuesday. XRP trades below its 50-, 100- and 200-day averages (about $1.27, $1.29 and $1.35), and the daily RSI momentum gauge is near 23 to 24, in oversold territory, which does not by itself signal a bottom (FXStreet). Analysts are watching $1.00 as the main support level; that is opinion, not a forecast.

Bitcoin held near $73,000 to $74,000 on Wednesday after Tuesday's hotter-than-expected October CPI, even as stocks rebounded on CoreWeave earnings; CME FedWatch put the odds of a quarter-point Fed hike in December near 90% (CoinDesk). US spot bitcoin ETFs had a fourth straight day of outflows ($95M on Tuesday), crypto futures liquidations jumped to about $725M in 24 hours, and XRP open interest fell 3.8% against a 1.8% price drop, a sign of leveraged money leaving rather than new shorts (CoinGlass via CoinDesk).

US spot XRP ETFs had no net flows on Wed Nov 11, after outflows of about $10.4M on Nov 9 and $7.6M on Nov 10 (SoSoValue via FXStreet, CryptoPotato). The last day with net inflows was Oct 29. Cumulative net inflows are about $1.8B and net assets about $1.2B.

On the XRP Ledger, the proposed native lending amendment has 22 of 35 trusted-validator votes, up from 19 in mid-October, and the SingleAssetVault amendment it depends on has 23; each needs 29 held for two straight weeks, so neither is live and there is no activation date (CoinDesk, Nov 12). The design offers fixed-term loans with no borrower collateral, relying on off-chain underwriting by loan brokers. Separately, XRPL developers will reset Testnet and Devnet on Nov 25, wiping test accounts; the main XRP Ledger is not affected (CryptoPotato).

At Ripple's Swell 2026 event, CEO Brad Garlinghouse said Ripple's large XRP holdings do not give it control of the XRP Ledger: Ripple runs one of the 35 validators on the recommended list, and holding XRP carries no voting weight (DailyCoin, Nov 10). Ripple does control the timing of its own escrow releases.

XRP Ledger payment volume jumped about 207% to about 1.16B XRP on Nov 9, roughly double its 30-day average (XRPScan data via TokenPost); that counts XRP moved in payments, including exchange transfers, and is not a measure of buying. Santiment counts about 343,500 wallets holding at least 10,000 XRP, up about 16,800 (5.2%) since Feb 9 (via Bitcoin.com News); wallet counts can shift with transfers and custody changes.

Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz said in X posts on Nov 9 and 10 that his holdings are down from a high of about 26M XRP to about 3M, from about 1,500 BTC to 1, and from about 40,000 ETH to 6; he sold about 2.5M XRP in 2025. He cited his own discomfort with risk, said sales are pre-arranged in writing with an attorney at least 30 days ahead, and still holds Ripple stock. He also told frustrated holders there is 'no secret plan' (crypto.news, Coinpedia). These are personal sales over years, not a new Ripple sale.

Binance reopened withdrawals for HYPE and APT (TokenPost, Nov 9) and is targeting about Fri Nov 13 for its remaining paused tokens (INJ, PLASMA, NEAR, LTC) and all tokens on already-restored networks; that is a target, not a guarantee (Binance Recovery Update #9 via MABOnChain). XRP withdrawals on the XRP Ledger reopened Nov 3 and XRP on Ethereum on Nov 6.

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals (The Block, Cointelegraph).

Ripple's November escrow cycle is complete: 1 billion XRP was released at 00:00 UTC Nov 1, and Ripple re-locked 700 million XRP in three new escrows that open in June and July 2029, leaving 300 million XRP outside escrow, the same pattern as September and October (TokenPost, Coinpaper, Whale Alert). That does not show the 300 million were sold.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'U.S. has signed a bill to replace FedNow with a next-generation payment system powered by XRP' and 'RealToken on XRP Ledger will unlock $650 trillion on Nov 14' posts are false; no such law or unlock exists. '$28,000 per XRP' price predictions and 'if you hold 500+ XRP you might already be a millionaire' posts are speculation with no source. 'Convert your funds into XRP as banks go cashless' and 'get money out of the bank / financial reset' posts are engagement bait with no official basis. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion' or '$73 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts or the 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades near $1.20 on every major venue. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'North Korea's $6.3 billion XRP heist' posts are wrong: the $6.3B was taken from Binance hot wallets across many networks and assets, not XRP alone. 'XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION' does not match Bitfinex's public margin data. 'Central banks agreed on a $5,000 set price for XRP' has no source. 'Explosive Goldman Sachs connection to XRP' is a teaser for a video with no document. 'Bloomberg spotlights XRP in 10 early races' misreads a Bloomberg election headline about House districts. 'Garlinghouse confirmed Ripple will become a major SWIFT shareholder by Nov 24' has no source. '$196.88 per XRP within days' posts label themselves rumors and give no basis. 'Bank of America announces an official large-scale partnership with Ripple' posts are false: neither company has announced one; BofA's documented link is as a connected bank in Ripple Treasury's (GTreasury) software gateway, not an XRP deal. 'Warren says the CLARITY Act will blow up the economy' recycles a May 2026 committee-hearing quote, not new news. 'Trump XRP payment claims, Nov 22' has no source. 'A $60 trillion bank just said which one it wants, XRP or XLM' is a video teaser with no named bank or document. 'Trump has signed an order opening 401(k)s to crypto' posts this weekend are not new: no new order was signed; the pending step is the Labor Department's final 401(k) alternatives rule, under White House review since Nov 5. '99.5% chance of XRP at $3,300 per coin, insane SEC filing' is a video teaser that names no filing. 'Frustrated XRP investors threatening to sell everything once they break even' is commentary, not data. 'Nearly $83 billion in XRP transfers recorded overnight' posts name no source or on-chain tracker, and follow the same template as earlier '$60 billion' and '$73 billion' posts. 'CNBC calls XRP the hottest crypto trade of the year' clips recycle a Jan 6, 2026 CNBC Power Lunch segment, when XRP was near $2.40. 'Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Fed Chair' is old news: he took office May 22, 2026. 'Fed XRP settlement testing' and '20% XRP burn' claims have no source. 'Former Ripple employee says this is where millionaires are made' names no one. 'ETF clients buy $3 million of XRP, bringing ETF net assets to $1.43 billion' is contradicted: XRP ETFs had about $10.4M of outflows on Nov 9 and net assets near $1.24B. 'XRP Ledger introduces quantum-proof accounts' overstates a draft roadmap design that is not live. 'Senator Van Hollen will not vote for the CLARITY Act' is not new: he opposed it in May and voted no on Sept 15. 'Former Goldman Sachs analyst warns $0.30 is next' names no one. 'A newly activated wallet received $167.7 million of XRP' gives no transaction or source. 'Ripple's founder dumped nearly all his XRP' posts misstate a real disclosure: David Schwartz is a former CTO and XRP Ledger co-architect, not Ripple's founder, and says he still holds about 3M XRP plus Ripple stock. 'Kazakhstan's central bank invested $100 million in crypto funds, including XRP' is half right: the roughly $100M fund allocation is reported (Bloomberg via crypto.news), but no report names XRP. 'Brad Garlinghouse says long-term XRP holders will be very happy, something big may be coming' gives no date, video or source. 'A valuation report says 500 XRP could be worth $1.1 million by 2028' names no report, implies about $2,200 per XRP, and is attached to a token promotion. '$280 million of certified diamonds tokenized on XRP' is recycled from February. 'A former SWIFT engineer predicts a $100 to $250 XRP repricing in 2027' names no engineer and gives no basis; it is a prediction, not news. 'Ripple Mint launches' posts dated this week recycle a July 23, 2026 Ripple announcement. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Ripple's bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
news.summary: The lending amendment rose from 19 to 22 validator votes since mid-October; it and the SingleAssetVault amendment each need 29 for two straight weeks. Loans would carry no borrower collateral and rely on off-chain underwriting.

news.headline: Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP trade under pressure as bottom signals remain elusive
news.summary: XRP near $1.04 with daily RSI about 23; XRP ETF flows were flat Wednesday after two days of outflows. Support and resistance levels are analyst opinion.

news.headline: Major XRP price update and important Ripple news: November 12
news.summary: Roundup: lending amendment at 22 votes, XRPL Testnet and Devnet reset on Nov 25 (mainnet unaffected), ETF flows flat Wednesday after two outflow days.

news.headline: XRP large wallets keep growing through a 30% slide toward $1.05
news.summary: Santiment counts about 343,500 wallets holding 10,000+ XRP, up about 16,800 since Feb 9. Wallet counts can change with transfers and custody arrangements.

news.headline: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows continue
news.summary: Bitcoin held near $74,000 as December hike odds rose to about 90%; bitcoin ETFs lost $95M Tuesday, liquidations hit $725M, and XRP open interest fell 3.8%.

news.headline: XRPL payment volume rises 207% to 1.16 billion XRP on Nov. 9
news.summary: XRPScan data show payment volume about double the 30-day average; it measures XRP moved in payments, not buying demand.

news.headline: XRP price falls to $1.06 as ETF outflows and bearish momentum weigh
news.summary: XRP dipped to about $1.03 intraday after trading above $1.10, with repeated failures to hold above $1.08; ETF outflows and weak sentiment cited. Support and resistance levels are analyst opinion.

news.headline: Ripple's David Schwartz says he sold most of his Bitcoin, XRP, Ethereum
news.summary: In X posts on Nov 9 and 10, Schwartz said his holdings fell from about 26M XRP to about 3M over the years, cited risk aversion, and said sales are pre-arranged with an attorney at least 30 days ahead.

news.headline: Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP struggle to find footing amid spot ETF outflows
news.summary: XRP spot ETFs saw nearly $8M of outflows on Tuesday, a second straight day; net assets about $1.19B. XRP near $1.06 with daily RSI about 24 (oversold).

news.headline: XRP sets a new 60-day low at $1.03
news.summary: XRP closed Tuesday near $1.055 after a $1.03011 low, the weakest in 60 daily sessions; it remains below its falling 20- and 50-day averages.

news.headline: Ripple CEO: big XRP holdings don't mean control
news.summary: At Swell 2026, Garlinghouse said holding XRP gives no control over ledger rules; Ripple runs one of 35 recommended validators.

news.headline: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data
news.summary: October CPI rose 0.4% versus 0.3% expected and core 0.3% versus 0.2%; yields jumped as traders priced in a December Fed hike, and bitcoin barely held $73,000 while ether, XRP and solana fell more.

news.headline: XRP Ledger's quantum plan needs owners to switch off old wallet keys
news.summary: A draft design in the XRPL Foundation's 2027 roadmap would let owners add a quantum-resistant ML-DSA-44 key and disable the old one, with no extra fee. Still in development; not live. Ripple targets a full transition by 2028.

news.headline: Binance targets Nov 13 to reopen withdrawals for six altcoins
news.summary: Recap of Recovery Update #9: HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC targeted by the end of next week; each route still needs security checks. No exact day given.

claims.check_title: CoinDesk: Ripple's bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger

claims.check: Matches Santiment data reported by Bitcoin.com News. Context: the rise is over nine months, not overnight, and wallet counts can change with transfers and custody arrangements; it does not show who is buying.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Former SWIFT engineer says most $XRP holders have NO IDEA how bullish 2027 could become. He predicts a MASSIVE repricing to $100-$250!
claims.check: Names no engineer, gives no basis, and no outlet reports it. A $100 price would value XRP at several trillion dollars. The same text is being copy-pasted across many small accounts, a common engagement pattern.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz says he sold nearly all his crypto, cutting holdings from 26M $XRP, 1,500 $BTC and 40,000 $ETH to ~3M $XRP, 1 $BTC and 6 $ETH.

claims.check: Accurate: it matches Schwartz's own X posts on Nov 9 and 10. Context: the sales happened over years, he cites personal risk aversion, sales are pre-arranged with an attorney, and he still holds about 3M XRP and Ripple stock. Posts calling him Ripple's 'founder' are wrong; he is a former CTO and XRP Ledger co-architect.

claims.check_title: crypto.news: Kazakhstan invests $190M as its $700M crypto reserve takes shape
